import bpy, math
sc = bpy.context.scene
fps = sc.render.fps / sc.render.fps_base
n = round(4 * fps)
f0 = 1
f1 = f0 + n

rig = bpy.data.objects.new("Rover", None)
rig.empty_display_type = 'PLAIN_AXES'
sc.collection.objects.link(rig)
for name in ["Rover_Body"] + [f"Rover_Wheel_{i}" for i in range(1, 5)]:
    o = bpy.data.objects[name]
    o.parent = rig  # rig sits at origin, identity inverse keeps positions

rig.rotation_mode = 'XYZ'
rig.rotation_euler = (0, 0, 0)
rig.keyframe_insert("rotation_euler", index=2, frame=f0)
rig.rotation_euler[2] = math.radians(360)
rig.keyframe_insert("rotation_euler", index=2, frame=f1)
for fc in rig.animation_data.action.fcurves:
    for kp in fc.keyframe_points:
        kp.interpolation = 'LINEAR'

sc.frame_start = f0
sc.frame_end = f1
sc.frame_set(f0)
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath="/tmp/work/rover.blend")
print("fps", fps, "frames", f0, f1, "saved", bpy.data.filepath)

bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath="/tmp/work/rover.blend")
